meaningEn: You, referring to more than one person; the usual plural form in Latin America and a formal plural form in most of Spain.
meaningKo: 여러 사람을 가리키는 이인칭 대명사. 라틴 아메리카에서는 일반적인 복수형이며 스페인 대부분 지역에서는 격식 있는 복수형으로 쓴다.
reason: The imported Korean definition incorrectly restricts ustedes to friends or younger people.

meaningEn: Popular; liked or supported by many people.
meaningKo: 인기가 많은; 많은 사람에게 사랑받거나 지지받는.
reason: The imported ordinary and secular sense does not match the selected popular adjective use.

meaningEn: Exactly or right, emphasising a precise place or time.
meaningKo: 정확히, 바로. 정확한 장소나 시간을 강조하는 말.
reason: The imported gloss defines proximity only; justo emphasises exactness in this use.

meaningEn: Style; a characteristic way of expressing something or creating a work.
meaningKo: 스타일, 양식. 무언가를 표현하거나 작품을 만드는 특징적인 방식.
reason: The imported definition describes a longstanding custom rather than a characteristic style.

meaningEn: Period or era; a span of time with particular characteristics.
meaningKo: 시기, 시대. 특정한 특징을 지닌 일정한 기간.
reason: The imported moment definition is too brief and does not capture a period or era.

meaningEn: Activity; an action, task or occupation that someone carries out.
meaningKo: 활동. 사람이 하는 행동이나 작업 또는 일.
reason: The imported definition describes striving for results rather than an activity.

meaningEn: Commission or fee charged for carrying out a service or transaction.
meaningKo: 수수료. 서비스나 거래를 처리한 대가로 받는 돈.
reason: The imported definition unnecessarily restricts the charge to governments or public bodies.

meaningEn: Fault or blame; responsibility for an error or harmful result.
meaningKo: 잘못, 책임. 실수나 해로운 결과에 대해 져야 하는 책임.
reason: The imported definition describes using something as an excuse rather than responsibility or blame.

meaningEn: To begin or start an action, event or process.
meaningKo: 시작하다. 행동이나 행사 또는 과정을 처음으로 진행하다.
reason: The imported definition wrongly limits empezar to opening a new shop.

meaningEn: Capture or seizure of a place, especially by force.
meaningKo: 점령, 함락. 특히 무력을 써서 장소를 차지하는 일.
reason: The imported definition describes repelling an enemy rather than taking possession of a place.

meaningEn: Mind; the faculty of thinking, remembering and understanding.
meaningKo: 마음, 정신. 생각하고 기억하며 이해하는 능력.
reason: The imported definition describes an attitude rather than the mind.

meaningEn: Teacher or instructor; a person who teaches a subject.
meaningKo: 교사, 강사. 과목이나 분야를 가르치는 사람.
reason: Remove Korean-specific honorific framing; profesor is an occupational noun.

meaningEn: Interesting; attracting attention or curiosity.
meaningKo: 흥미로운. 관심이나 호기심을 끄는.
reason: The imported joyful and pleasant definition does not define interesting.

meaningEn: The press; newspapers, news publications and the journalists who work for them.
meaningKo: 언론, 신문계. 신문과 보도 매체 또는 그곳에서 일하는 기자들.
reason: The imported definition describes the act of reporting rather than the press.

meaningEn: Grammatical gender; a category such as masculine or feminine that affects agreement.
meaningKo: 문법적 성. 남성이나 여성처럼 어형의 일치에 영향을 주는 문법 범주.
reason: Replace the inherited biological-sex definition with a clear grammatical-gender sense for this entry.

meaningEn: Application; the act of putting a rule, method or treatment into practice.
meaningKo: 적용. 규칙이나 방법 또는 처치를 실제로 시행하는 일.
reason: The imported job-application sense reflects a false-friend mapping; Spanish normally uses solicitud for that meaning.

meaningEn: Saint; a person recognised as holy, especially by a religious community.
meaningKo: 성인. 특히 종교 공동체에서 거룩하다고 인정하는 사람.
reason: The imported wise moral exemplar definition does not adequately describe a religious saint.

meaningEn: Owner or master, especially of an animal.
meaningKo: 주인. 특히 동물을 소유하고 돌보는 사람.
reason: The imported definition restricts amo to a person paying an employee; use the clear owner sense.

meaningEn: Boy or young man.
meaningKo: 소년, 젊은 남자.
reason: Remove the imported Korean-specific disparaging term for one’s own child.

meaningEn: When; at the time that something happens.
meaningKo: ~할 때. 어떤 일이 일어나는 시점을 나타내는 말.
reason: Unaccented cuando is a relative temporal adverb, not interrogative cuándo.

meaningEn: Fate or destiny, regarded as determining the course of a life.
meaningKo: 운명. 삶의 흐름을 정한다고 여겨지는 힘이나 정해진 삶의 경로.
reason: Remove the imported restriction to the Korean birth-date divination concept.

meaningEn: You; the familiar singular subject pronoun.
meaningKo: 너. 친근하게 한 사람을 가리킬 때 쓰는 이인칭 단수 주어 대명사.
reason: The imported definition described a Korean inflected pronoun rather than Spanish tú.

meaningEn: Several or various; more than one, without specifying an exact number.
meaningKo: 여러, 몇몇. 둘 이상임을 나타내되 정확한 수는 정하지 않는 말.
reason: Varios does not necessarily mean a large number as the imported definition claimed.

meaningEn: The second one; the person or thing in the position after the first.
meaningKo: 두 번째 사람이나 것. 첫 번째 다음 위치에 있는 대상.
reason: The imported definition incorrectly described a cardinal total of two; select a substantivised ordinal sense.

meaningEn: Video; a recording of moving images, usually with sound.
meaningKo: 영상, 비디오. 보통 소리를 함께 담은 움직이는 화면의 기록.
reason: Select the widely used recording sense, retaining the valid Latin American spelling video.

meaningEn: Path or way along which people or vehicles travel.
meaningKo: 길. 사람이나 차량이 다니는 통로.
reason: The imported fixed sea or air route definition was overly restricted for camino.

meaningEn: Speech; the way a person speaks.
meaningKo: 말씨, 말하기 방식. 사람이 말을 하는 방식.
reason: The imported definition described voice rather than speech or manner of speaking.

meaningEn: Age; the length of time a person or animal has lived.
meaningKo: 나이. 사람이나 동물이 살아온 기간.
reason: Remove Korean-specific honorific framing absent from Spanish edad.

meaningEn: Stocking; a close-fitting garment covering the foot and extending up the leg.
meaningKo: 스타킹. 발부터 다리 위쪽까지 덮는 몸에 붙는 의류.
reason: Choose the standard stocking sense rather than an unmarked generic sock gloss.

meaningEn: Band; a group of musicians who perform together.
meaningKo: 악단, 밴드. 함께 연주하는 음악가들의 모임.
reason: Replace the broad inherited group-of-people-or-animals definition with a clear music-band sense.

meaningEn: Stranger; a person whom one does not know.
meaningKo: 낯선 사람. 자신이 알지 못하는 사람.
reason: The imported definition incorrectly equated a stranger with a foreign national.

meaningEn: Blow or impact; a forceful contact with a person or object.
meaningKo: 타격, 충격. 사람이나 물체에 세게 닿는 일.
reason: The imported definition describes a specialised baseball hit rather than a general golpe.

meaningEn: Open tournament; a sporting competition admitting entrants from different categories or associations.
meaningKo: 오픈 대회. 여러 범주나 협회의 참가자에게 출전 기회를 주는 스포츠 대회.
reason: The inherited noun entry contained an adjective definition; use the established tournament noun sense without duplicating the existing adjective entry.

meaningEn: Flat or apartment; a separate dwelling within a building.
meaningKo: 아파트 한 채. 한 건물 안에서 독립된 주거 공간을 이루는 집.
reason: The imported definition confused an individual apartment with the entire apartment building.

meaningEn: Just or newly; a short time before the moment being described.
meaningKo: 갓, 막. 말하는 시점보다 얼마 전에 이루어진 일을 나타내는 말.
reason: The imported definition meant only now or for the first time, which does not cover recién hecho.

meaningEn: Post or postal service; the service that transports and delivers letters and parcels.
meaningKo: 우편, 우편 서비스. 편지와 소포를 운송하고 배달하는 서비스.
reason: The inherited definition conflated the service with a post-office building and banking functions.

meaningEn: Figure; the outline or shape of a person’s body.
meaningKo: 모습, 체형. 사람 몸의 윤곽이나 형태.
reason: Remove the inherited restriction to a woman’s beautiful appearance.

meaningEn: Player; someone who takes part in a game or sport.
meaningKo: 선수, 참가자. 경기나 게임에 참여하는 사람.
reason: The inherited definition incorrectly restricted jugador to a professional gambler.

meaningEn: Secretary; a person who handles correspondence, records or administrative arrangements.
meaningKo: 비서, 서기. 서신이나 기록 또는 행정 업무를 처리하는 사람.
reason: The imported definition referred to a Korean fourth-grade civil-service rank rather than secretario.

meaningEn: Average or arithmetic mean; the sum of a set of values divided by the number of values.
meaningKo: 평균, 산술 평균. 여러 값을 모두 더한 뒤 값의 개수로 나눈 수.
reason: The inherited middle-value definition could be mistaken for the median.

meaningEn: Field or area of activity, knowledge or discussion.
meaningKo: 분야, 영역. 활동이나 지식 또는 논의의 범위.
reason: The imported society or world definition was too broad for the figurative terreno sense.

meaningEn: Murder; the intentional unlawful killing of a person.
meaningKo: 살인. 사람을 의도적으로 불법하게 죽이는 일.
reason: The inherited definition omitted the intentional criminal nature of asesinato.

meaningEn: Sweet or piece of confectionery.
meaningKo: 사탕, 단 과자. 단맛이 나는 간식.
reason: Remove the inherited restriction to hard sweets made from Korean yeot.

meaningEn: To use something for a purpose.
meaningKo: 사용하다. 어떤 목적을 위해 무언가를 쓰다.
reason: The inherited definition incorrectly restricted utilizar to moving body parts.

meaningEn: Clearly; in a way that is easy to perceive or understand.
meaningKo: 명확하게, 또렷하게. 알아보거나 이해하기 쉽게.
reason: The inherited definition described the clarity of colour rather than the adverb clearly.

meaningEn: Writer; a person who creates written works such as books, stories or scripts.
meaningKo: 작가. 책이나 이야기 또는 대본 같은 글을 쓰는 사람.
reason: Remove painting and drawing from the imported writer definition.

meaningEn: Initiative; readiness or the act of being first to propose or begin something.
meaningKo: 주도, 솔선. 어떤 일을 먼저 제안하거나 시작하는 태도 또는 행동.
reason: The inherited definition framed initiative as formal right or authority rather than taking the lead.

meaningEn: League; an organised group of sports teams that compete against one another.
meaningKo: 리그. 서로 경기를 치르는 스포츠 팀들의 조직된 집합.
reason: The inherited definition described each team rather than the league.

meaningEn: To defend or protect someone or something against attack, criticism or an accusation.
meaningKo: 방어하다, 변호하다. 공격이나 비판 또는 혐의에 맞서 사람이나 대상을 지키다.
reason: The inherited definition described general behind-the-scenes support rather than defence.

meaningEn: Offer; a proposal to provide something or to do something for someone.
meaningKo: 제안. 무언가를 제공하거나 누군가를 위해 어떤 일을 하겠다는 의사 표시.
reason: The inherited definition described the act of supplying something rather than making an offer.

meaningEn: Probably or most likely; expressing a strong expectation without certainty.
meaningKo: 아마, 십중팔구. 확실하지는 않지만 가능성이 높다고 생각할 때 쓰는 말.
reason: The inherited definition asserted certainty, whereas common seguramente expresses probability.

meaningEn: Climate; the characteristic weather patterns of a place over a long period.
meaningKo: 기후. 오랜 기간에 걸쳐 나타나는 한 지역의 전형적인 날씨 양상.
reason: The inherited definition described momentary weather without the longer-term climate distinction.

meaningEn: Intervention or contribution; taking part in a situation, activity or discussion.
meaningKo: 참여, 개입, 발언. 상황이나 활동 또는 논의에 관여하는 일.
reason: The inherited definition incorrectly made all intervention unsolicited meddling.

meaningEn: Agency; an organisation providing specialised services or acting on behalf of clients.
meaningKo: 대행사. 전문 서비스를 제공하거나 고객을 대신해 일을 처리하는 기관.
reason: The inherited definition merely described a company to which someone belongs.

meaningEn: Town or city council; the institution responsible for municipal administration.
meaningKo: 시청, 지방 자치 행정 기관. 도시의 행정을 담당하는 기관.
reason: The inherited definition incorrectly called municipal government a national agency.

meaningEn: Permanent; intended or expected to last, rather than temporary.
meaningKo: 영구적인, 상시적인. 일시적이지 않고 계속 유지될 것으로 의도되거나 예상되는.
reason: The inherited definition unnecessarily required literal infinite duration.

meaningEn: Integer; a whole number without a fractional part.
meaningKo: 정수. 소수나 분수 부분이 없는 수.
reason: Select the established mathematical noun sense for an unambiguous learner example.

meaningEn: Noise; a sound, especially one that is loud, unwanted or disturbing.
meaningKo: 소음. 특히 크거나 원하지 않거나 방해가 되는 소리.
reason: The inherited definition restricted noise to chaotic speech or behaviour.

meaningEn: Virgin; a person who has not had sexual intercourse.
meaningKo: 성관계 경험이 없는 사람.
reason: The inherited definition unnecessarily restricted virginity to women and opposite-sex intercourse.

meaningEn: Cash; money in the form of notes and coins.
meaningKo: 현금. 지폐와 동전 형태의 돈.
reason: The inherited definition confused cash with any payment made immediately.

meaningEn: Personality; the characteristic combination of a person’s ways of thinking, feeling and behaving.
meaningKo: 성격. 한 사람에게 특징적으로 나타나는 사고, 감정, 행동 방식의 조합.
reason: Remove the unsupported claim that personality is entirely present at birth.

meaningEn: Alternative; another available option or course of action.
meaningKo: 대안. 선택할 수 있는 다른 방법이나 행동 방안.
reason: The inherited generic plan definition omitted the availability of another option.

meaningEn: End or extremity; the part furthest from the centre or the opposite end.
meaningKo: 끝, 말단. 중심이나 반대쪽 끝에서 가장 먼 부분.
reason: The inherited definition described a left or right side, not an end.

meaningEn: Patient; able to wait or deal with difficulty calmly without becoming annoyed.
meaningKo: 참을성 있는. 기다림이나 어려움을 짜증 내지 않고 차분하게 견디는.
reason: The inherited definition described strength and persistence rather than patient tolerance.

meaningEn: Pay; money received for work.
meaningKo: 급여, 보수. 일한 대가로 받는 돈.
reason: The inherited definition described settling a purchase rather than pay.

meaningEn: Only or solely; excluding all other possibilities.
meaningKo: 오직, ~만. 다른 가능성을 모두 제외하고.
reason: The inherited definition incorrectly included being few in number.

meaningEn: Agent; the participant that performs the action expressed by a verb.
meaningKo: 행위자. 동사가 나타내는 행동을 수행하는 참여자.
reason: The inherited definition conflated a semantic agent with any grammatical subject, including states.

meaningEn: Madness; a non-technical, sometimes disparaging term for severely irrational thinking or behaviour.
meaningKo: 광기. 매우 비합리적인 사고나 행동을 가리키는 비전문적 표현으로, 비하하는 뜻으로도 쓰인다.
reason: Avoid presenting the historical or colloquial word as a precise clinical definition.

meaningEn: Obvious; clear and easy to notice or understand.
meaningKo: 명백한. 쉽게 알아차리거나 이해할 수 있을 만큼 분명한.
reason: The inherited definition restricted the adjective to behaviour, attitudes or character.

meaningEn: Painting or picture, especially one displayed on a wall.
meaningKo: 그림, 회화. 특히 벽에 걸어 놓는 그림.
reason: The imported definition described a frame, which is normally marco.

meaningEn: Talent; a natural aptitude or ability for an activity.
meaningKo: 재능. 어떤 활동을 잘할 수 있는 타고난 소질이나 능력.
reason: Remove imported slang framing and the restriction to performing before an audience.

meaningEn: Chemical element; a substance consisting of atoms with the same atomic number.
meaningKo: 화학 원소. 원자 번호가 같은 원자들로 이루어진 물질.
reason: The imported smallest indivisible component definition was scientifically inaccurate without a chemical distinction.

meaningEn: Legislation; the laws governing an area of activity or a jurisdiction.
meaningKo: 법률, 법규. 특정 활동이나 관할 지역에 적용되는 법들의 집합.
reason: The imported definition described turning a rule into law rather than the body of laws.

meaningEn: Handling or operation; using or controlling something.
meaningKo: 조작, 다루기. 무언가를 사용하거나 조종하는 일.
reason: Remove unsupported slang framing and the restriction to manipulating people as desired.

meaningEn: Progress; advance or development towards a goal or a better state.
meaningKo: 진전, 발전. 목표나 더 나은 상태를 향해 나아가는 일.
reason: The inherited definition omitted forward development and described any unfolding.

meaningEn: Subject; the grammatical element about which a clause makes a statement and with which the verb normally agrees.
meaningKo: 주어. 절에서 서술의 대상이 되며 보통 동사와 인칭 및 수가 일치하는 문장 성분.
reason: Avoid treating every subject as the semantic agent or requiring a fixed sentence position.

meaningEn: Count; a European title of nobility or a person holding that title.
meaningKo: 백작. 유럽의 귀족 작위 또는 그 작위를 가진 사람.
reason: Remove the unsupported claim of a universal five-rank nobility system.

meaningEn: Hill or mountain; a natural elevation of the land.
meaningKo: 산, 언덕. 주변 땅보다 자연적으로 높이 솟은 지형.
reason: The inherited definition incorrectly required a cluster of lofty rugged mountains.

meaningEn: Rest or break; a pause in activity to recover energy.
meaningKo: 휴식. 기운을 회복하려고 활동을 잠시 멈추는 일.

meanings.de: Pause oder Erholung; Unterbrechung einer Tätigkeit, um neue Kraft zu schöpfen.
meanings.fr: Repos ou pause permettant de reprendre des forces.
meanings.ja: 休憩。力を回復するために活動を一時中断すること。
meanings.zh: 休息；为恢复精力而暂时停止活动。

reason: The inherited definition described spare time rather than rest.

meaningEn: Introduction; the opening section that presents a text or topic.
meaningKo: 서론, 도입부. 글이나 주제를 소개하는 첫 부분.

meanings.de: Einleitung; eröffnender Abschnitt eines Textes oder Themas.
meanings.fr: Introduction ; partie initiale qui présente un texte ou un sujet.
meanings.ja: 序文、導入。文章や話題を紹介する最初の部分。
meanings.zh: 引言；介绍文章或主题的开头部分。

reason: The inherited interpersonal-introduction sense normally uses presentación; select the textual introduction sense.

meaningEn: Maintenance; work done to keep equipment or a building in good condition.
meaningKo: 유지 관리, 정비. 장비나 건물을 좋은 상태로 유지하는 작업.

meanings.de: Wartung oder Instandhaltung von Geräten oder Gebäuden.
meanings.fr: Entretien permettant de maintenir un équipement ou un bâtiment en bon état.
meanings.ja: 保守、整備。設備や建物を良い状態に保つ作業。
meanings.zh: 维护、保养；使设备或建筑保持良好状态的工作。

reason: The inherited definition described caring for dependent people rather than maintenance.

meaningEn: Relatively; in comparison with something else.
meaningKo: 비교적. 다른 것과 비교해서.

meanings.de: relativ; im Vergleich zu etwas anderem
meanings.fr: relativement ; par comparaison avec autre chose
meanings.ja: 比較的。他のものと比べて。
meanings.zh: 相对地；与其他事物相比。

reason: The inherited definition omitted the comparative nature of relativamente.

meaningEn: Advance or progress; movement towards completion or improvement.
meaningKo: 진전. 완성이나 개선을 향해 나아감.

meanings.de: Fortschritt; Entwicklung hin zu einem Ziel oder einer Verbesserung.
meanings.fr: Avancée ou progrès vers un achèvement ou une amélioration.
meanings.ja: 進展。完成や改善に向けて進むこと。
meanings.zh: 进展；向完成或改善迈进。

reason: The inherited definition described any development without specifying advance.

meaningEn: Lieutenant; a commissioned military officer below a captain.
meaningKo: 중위. 대위보다 아래에 있는 장교 계급.

meanings.de: Leutnant; Offiziersrang unterhalb eines Hauptmanns.
meanings.fr: Lieutenant ; grade d’officier inférieur à celui de capitaine.
meanings.ja: 中尉。大尉より下位の士官の階級。
meanings.zh: 中尉；低于上尉的军官军衔。

reason: The inherited definition confused a rank with the appointment of platoon leader.

meaningEn: The third one; the person or thing after the first and second.
meaningKo: 세 번째 사람이나 것. 첫째와 둘째 다음에 있는 대상.

meanings.de: der Dritte; die Person oder Sache nach der ersten und zweiten.
meanings.fr: Le troisième ; personne ou chose venant après la première et la deuxième.
meanings.ja: 三番目の人や物。最初と二番目に続くもの。
meanings.zh: 第三个；排在第一和第二之后的人或事物。

reason: The inherited definition described a cardinal total of three rather than an ordinal.

meaningEn: Storm; a period of severe weather, often with strong wind, rain or thunder.
meaningKo: 폭풍, 폭풍우. 강풍이나 비 또는 천둥을 동반하는 심한 날씨.

meanings.de: Sturm oder Unwetter, oft mit starkem Wind, Regen oder Donner.
meanings.fr: Tempête ou orage ; épisode de mauvais temps intense.
meanings.ja: 嵐。強風、雨、雷などを伴う荒れた天候。
meanings.zh: 风暴或暴风雨；常伴随强风、雨或雷的恶劣天气。

reason: The inherited definition reduced tormenta to wind alone.

meaningEn: Engineer; a professional who applies scientific and technical knowledge to design or build systems and structures.
meaningKo: 공학자, 엔지니어. 과학과 기술 지식을 활용해 시스템이나 구조물을 설계하거나 만드는 전문가.

meanings.de: Ingenieur; Fachperson für die technische Planung und Entwicklung von Systemen oder Bauwerken.
meanings.fr: Ingénieur ; professionnel qui applique les sciences et les techniques à la conception de systèmes ou de structures.
meanings.ja: 技術者。科学や技術の知識を応用してシステムや構造物を設計する専門家。
meanings.zh: 工程师；运用科学和技术知识设计系统或结构的专业人员。

reason: The inherited definition described any skilled technician without the engineering distinction.

meaningEn: To steal; to take someone else’s property without permission.
meaningKo: 훔치다. 허락 없이 다른 사람의 재산을 가져가다.

meanings.de: stehlen; fremdes Eigentum ohne Erlaubnis nehmen
meanings.fr: voler ; prendre le bien d’autrui sans autorisation
meanings.ja: 盗む。許可なく他人の所有物を取る。
meanings.zh: 偷窃；未经允许拿走他人的财物。

reason: The inherited definition unnecessarily required breaking into a storage location and stealing everything.

meaningEn: Experienced or lived through; actually undergone by someone.
meaningKo: 겪은, 경험한. 누군가가 실제로 거친.

meanings.de: erlebt; tatsächlich erfahren
meanings.fr: vécu ; dont quelqu’un a fait l’expérience
meanings.ja: 経験した、体験した。
meanings.zh: 经历过的；亲身体验过的。

reason: Unaccented vivido is the participle of vivir. A separate vívido adjective entry already exists, so preserve the word and correct its meaning.

meaningEn: Warrior; a person who fights in war or battle.
meaningKo: 전사. 전쟁이나 전투에서 싸우는 사람.

meanings.de: Krieger; jemand, der in einem Krieg oder Kampf kämpft.
meanings.fr: Guerrier ; personne qui combat dans une guerre ou une bataille.
meanings.ja: 戦士。戦争や戦闘で戦う人。
meanings.zh: 战士；参加战争或战斗的人。

reason: The inherited definition described a professional martial artist rather than a warrior.

meaningEn: Constantly or continuously; without interruption or with frequent repetition.
meaningKo: 계속, 끊임없이. 중단 없이 또는 자주 반복하여.

meanings.de: ständig oder ununterbrochen; ohne Unterbrechung oder sehr häufig
meanings.fr: constamment ; sans interruption ou de façon très répétée
meanings.ja: 絶えず、常に。中断なく、または頻繁に繰り返して。
meanings.zh: 不断地；不中断或频繁重复地。

reason: The inherited definition described only remaining unchanged, omitting continuity or repetition.

meaningEn: Focusing; adjustment of a lens to make an image sharp.
meaningKo: 초점 맞추기. 영상이 선명해지도록 렌즈를 조절하는 일.

meanings.de: Fokussierung; Einstellen einer Linse, damit ein Bild scharf wird.
meanings.fr: Mise au point ; réglage d’un objectif pour obtenir une image nette.
meanings.ja: ピント合わせ。像が鮮明になるようレンズを調整すること。
meanings.zh: 对焦；调整镜头使影像清晰。

reason: The inherited definition described the focal point, normally foco, rather than the act or setting of focus.

meaningEn: Evaluation; assessment of the quality, value or results of something.
meaningKo: 평가. 무언가의 품질이나 가치 또는 결과를 판단하는 일.

meanings.de: Bewertung; Beurteilung von Qualität, Wert oder Ergebnissen.
meanings.fr: Évaluation ; appréciation de la qualité, de la valeur ou des résultats.
meanings.ja: 評価。品質、価値、結果などを判断すること。
meanings.zh: 评估；判断质量、价值或结果。

reason: The inherited definition described a trial before implementation rather than evaluation in general.

meaningEn: Exploitation; taking unfair advantage of someone’s work or vulnerability.
meaningKo: 착취. 다른 사람의 노동이나 취약한 처지를 부당하게 이용하는 일.

meanings.de: Ausbeutung; unfaire Nutzung der Arbeit oder Verletzlichkeit anderer.
meanings.fr: Exploitation ; fait de tirer injustement profit du travail ou de la vulnérabilité d’autrui.
meanings.ja: 搾取。他人の労働や弱い立場を不当に利用すること。
meanings.zh: 剥削；不公平地利用他人的劳动或弱势地位。

reason: The inherited definition limited exploitation to forcibly taking possessions.

meaningEn: To start or begin an action or process.
meaningKo: 시작하다. 행동이나 과정을 처음 진행하다.

meanings.de: beginnen; eine Handlung oder einen Vorgang starten
meanings.fr: commencer ; mettre en route une action ou un processus
meanings.ja: 始める。行動や過程を開始する。
meanings.zh: 开始；启动行动或过程。

reason: The inherited definition described originating in a place or event rather than starting something.

meaningEn: To mention; to refer briefly to someone or something.
meaningKo: 언급하다. 사람이나 사물을 짧게 이야기하다.

meanings.de: erwähnen; kurz auf jemanden oder etwas Bezug nehmen
meanings.fr: mentionner ; faire brièvement référence à quelqu’un ou à quelque chose
meanings.ja: 言及する。人や物事について短く触れる。
meanings.zh: 提及；简要说到某人或某事。

reason: Remove the inherited implication that mentioning is useless or repeated.

meaningEn: To escape or get away from confinement, danger or pursuit.
meaningKo: 탈출하다, 달아나다. 갇힌 곳이나 위험 또는 추격에서 벗어나다.

meanings.de: entkommen oder fliehen; sich aus Gefangenschaft, Gefahr oder Verfolgung befreien
meanings.fr: s’échapper ou fuir un enfermement, un danger ou une poursuite
meanings.ja: 逃げる、脱出する。閉じ込められた場所や危険、追跡から離れる。
meanings.zh: 逃脱；摆脱拘禁、危险或追赶。

reason: Remove the Korean-source slang framing and the requirement for exceptionally rapid movement.

meaningEn: Radical; a person advocating fundamental changes, especially in politics or society.
meaningKo: 급진주의자. 특히 정치나 사회에서 근본적인 변화를 주장하는 사람.

meanings.de: Radikaler; Person, die grundlegende politische oder gesellschaftliche Veränderungen fordert.
meanings.fr: Radical ; personne qui défend des changements fondamentaux, notamment politiques ou sociaux.
meanings.ja: 急進派。特に政治や社会の抜本的な変革を求める人。
meanings.zh: 激进派；主张政治或社会发生根本变革的人。

reason: The inherited definition was exclusively disparaging and stronger than the unqualified Spanish noun.

meaningEn: Funny or amusing; causing laughter or enjoyment.
meaningKo: 웃긴, 재미있는. 웃음이나 즐거움을 주는.

meanings.de: lustig oder witzig; zum Lachen anregend
meanings.fr: drôle ou amusant ; qui fait rire
meanings.ja: 面白い、おかしい。笑いや楽しさをもたらす。
meanings.zh: 有趣的、好笑的；使人发笑或愉快的。

reason: The inherited Korean homely/candid speech sense did not match gracioso.

meaningEn: Width; the distance from one side to the other.
meaningKo: 너비. 한쪽 끝에서 다른 쪽 끝까지의 가로 거리.

meanings.de: Breite; Abstand von einer Seite zur anderen.
meanings.fr: Largeur ; distance d’un côté à l’autre.
meanings.ja: 幅。一方の側から反対側までの距離。
meanings.zh: 宽度；从一侧到另一侧的距离。

reason: The inherited definition confused width with area.

meaningEn: Desert; a region that receives very little rainfall.
meaningKo: 사막. 비가 매우 적게 내리는 지역.

meanings.de: Wüste; Gebiet mit sehr geringen Niederschlägen.
meanings.fr: Désert ; région qui reçoit très peu de précipitations.
meanings.ja: 砂漠。降水量が非常に少ない地域。
meanings.zh: 沙漠；降水极少的地区。

reason: The inherited definition incorrectly required sand and nearly no living things.

meaningEn: Duke; a high-ranking European title of nobility or a person holding it.
meaningKo: 공작. 유럽의 높은 귀족 작위 또는 그 작위를 가진 사람.

meanings.de: Herzog; hoher europäischer Adelstitel oder dessen Träger.
meanings.fr: Duc ; titre élevé de la noblesse européenne ou personne qui le porte.
meanings.ja: 公爵。ヨーロッパの高位の貴族の称号、またはその保持者。
meanings.zh: 公爵；欧洲的高级贵族爵位或其持有者。

reason: Remove the unsupported claim of a universal five-rank nobility system.

meaningEn: The fifth one; the person or thing after the first four.
meaningKo: 다섯 번째 사람이나 것. 앞의 넷 다음에 오는 대상.

meanings.de: der Fünfte; Person oder Sache nach den ersten vier.
meanings.fr: Le cinquième ; personne ou chose venant après les quatre premières.
meanings.ja: 五番目の人や物。最初の四つに続くもの。
meanings.zh: 第五个；排在前四个之后的人或事物。

reason: The inherited definition described a cardinal total of five rather than an ordinal.

meaningEn: The accused; a person charged with a criminal offence.
meaningKo: 피고인. 형사 범죄로 기소된 사람.

meanings.de: Angeklagter; Person, der eine Straftat vorgeworfen wird.
meanings.fr: Accusé ; personne poursuivie pour une infraction pénale.
meanings.ja: 被告人。犯罪を犯したとして起訴された人。
meanings.zh: 被告；被指控犯有刑事罪行的人。

reason: The inherited definition described a defendant in a civil dispute rather than a person accused of a crime.

meaningEn: Strike; a collective stoppage of work as a form of protest or to seek demands.
meaningKo: 파업. 요구를 관철하거나 항의하기 위해 집단으로 일을 중단하는 행위.

meanings.de: Streik; gemeinschaftliche Arbeitsniederlegung als Protest oder zur Durchsetzung von Forderungen.
meanings.fr: Grève ; arrêt collectif du travail pour protester ou obtenir satisfaction de revendications.
meanings.ja: ストライキ。抗議や要求の実現のために集団で仕事を止めること。
meanings.zh: 罢工；为抗议或争取诉求而集体停止工作。

reason: The inherited definition described any interruption of an activity, omitting labour protest.

meaningEn: Follow-up or monitoring; continued observation of how something develops.
meaningKo: 추적 관찰, 진행 확인. 무언가가 어떻게 진행되는지 계속 살피는 일.

meanings.de: Nachverfolgung oder Kontrolle eines Verlaufs.
meanings.fr: Suivi ; observation continue de l’évolution de quelque chose.
meanings.ja: 経過観察、追跡。物事の進み方を継続して確かめること。
meanings.zh: 跟进、监测；持续观察事物的发展。

reason: The inherited definition described copying old traditions rather than following progress.

meaningEn: Actress; a woman who performs roles in theatre, film or television.
meaningKo: 여배우. 연극이나 영화 또는 텔레비전에서 배역을 연기하는 여성.

meanings.de: Schauspielerin; Frau, die Rollen auf der Bühne, im Film oder im Fernsehen spielt.
meanings.fr: Actrice ; femme qui interprète des rôles au théâtre, au cinéma ou à la télévision.
meanings.ja: 女優。舞台、映画、テレビで役を演じる女性。
meanings.zh: 女演员；在戏剧、电影或电视中扮演角色的女性。

reason: The inherited definition included male actors and unnecessarily restricted the medium to television.

meaningEn: Worship; religious acts of devotion or reverence towards a deity.
meaningKo: 예배, 숭배. 신에게 헌신이나 공경을 나타내는 종교 행위.

meanings.de: Kult oder Anbetung; religiöse Verehrung einer Gottheit.
meanings.fr: Culte ; actes religieux de dévotion envers une divinité.
meanings.ja: 礼拝、崇拝。神への信仰や敬意を表す宗教的行為。
meanings.zh: 崇拜、礼拜；对神表示虔诚或敬意的宗教行为。

reason: The inherited definition wrongly restricted worship to bowing.

meaningEn: Depression or deep dejection; more than an ordinary passing bad mood in clinical usage.
meaningKo: 우울, 깊은 의기소침. 임상적으로 쓰일 때는 일시적인 나쁜 기분만을 뜻하지 않는다.

meanings.de: Depression oder tiefe Niedergeschlagenheit; im klinischen Gebrauch mehr als eine vorübergehend schlechte Stimmung.
meanings.fr: Dépression ou profond abattement ; au sens clinique, ce terme dépasse une simple mauvaise humeur passagère.
meanings.ja: 抑うつ、深い落ち込み。臨床的には一時的な不機嫌だけを意味しない。
meanings.zh: 抑郁或深度消沉；临床用法并非仅指短暂的坏心情。

reason: The inherited Korean-source bad-mood idiom trivialised the Spanish term; keep literary use and flag clinical distinction without diagnostic claims.

meaningEn: Flow; continuous movement of a liquid or another substance.
meaningKo: 흐름. 액체나 다른 물질이 계속 이동하는 현상.

meanings.de: Fluss oder Strömung einer Flüssigkeit oder eines anderen Stoffes.
meanings.fr: Flux ; mouvement continu d’un liquide ou d’une autre substance.
meanings.ja: 流れ。液体などの物質が連続して動くこと。
meanings.zh: 流动；液体或其他物质的连续运动。

reason: The inherited definition described a long streak of light, fire or water rather than flow.

meaningEn: Fixed or steady; staying directed at the same point without moving.
meaningKo: 고정된. 움직이지 않고 같은 지점을 향하는.

meanings.de: fest oder unbeweglich; auf denselben Punkt gerichtet
meanings.fr: fixe ; dirigé vers le même point sans bouger
meanings.ja: 固定された。動かず同じ点に向いている。
meanings.zh: 固定的；不移动而朝向同一点的。

reason: The inherited definition described clear staring eyes instead of a fixed or steady gaze.

meaningEn: Grey; a colour between black and white.
meaningKo: 회색. 검은색과 흰색 사이의 색.

meanings.de: Grau; Farbe zwischen Schwarz und Weiß.
meanings.fr: Gris ; couleur entre le noir et le blanc.
meanings.ja: 灰色。黒と白の中間の色。
meanings.zh: 灰色；介于黑色和白色之间的颜色。

reason: The inherited politically uncommitted grey metaphor was not reliable as the selected Spanish noun sense; use the basic colour sense.

meaningEn: Youthful or relating to young people.
meaningKo: 젊은, 청소년의. 젊은 사람과 관련되거나 젊음이 느껴지는.

meanings.de: jugendlich; die Jugend betreffend
meanings.fr: juvénile ; relatif à la jeunesse ou plein de jeunesse
meanings.ja: 若々しい、若者の。若者に関係する、または若さを感じさせる。
meanings.zh: 年轻的、青年的；与年轻人有关或有青春气息的。

reason: The inherited definition described vigorous energy alone and omitted youth.

meaningEn: Demonstration; a public gathering expressing an opinion or demand.
meaningKo: 시위. 의견이나 요구를 공개적으로 나타내기 위한 모임.

meanings.de: Demonstration; öffentliche Versammlung zum Ausdruck einer Meinung oder Forderung.
meanings.fr: Manifestation ; rassemblement public exprimant une opinion ou une revendication.
meanings.ja: デモ。意見や要求を公に示すための集まり。
meanings.zh: 示威；公开表达意见或诉求的集会。

reason: The inherited definition incorrectly made intimidation or recognition the necessary purpose.

meaningEn: Sauce; a liquid or semi-liquid preparation served with food for flavour.
meaningKo: 소스. 음식에 맛을 더하려고 곁들이는 액체나 반액체 형태의 조리물.

meanings.de: Soße; flüssige oder halbflüssige Zubereitung zur geschmacklichen Ergänzung von Speisen.
meanings.fr: Sauce ; préparation liquide ou semi-liquide qui accompagne un aliment.
meanings.ja: ソース。料理に風味を加える液状または半液状の調製物。
meanings.zh: 酱汁；为食物增添风味的液态或半液态调制品。

reason: The inherited generic seasoning definition was too broad for salsa.

meaningEn: Trade union; an organisation representing workers and their interests.
meaningKo: 노동조합. 노동자와 그 이익을 대표하는 조직.

meanings.de: Gewerkschaft; Organisation zur Vertretung von Arbeitnehmerinteressen.
meanings.fr: Syndicat ; organisation représentant les travailleurs et leurs intérêts.
meanings.ja: 労働組合。労働者とその利益を代表する組織。
meanings.zh: 工会；代表劳动者及其利益的组织。

reason: The inherited definition described any association and omitted worker representation.

meaningEn: Inflation; a sustained increase in the general level of prices.
meaningKo: 인플레이션, 물가 상승. 전반적인 가격 수준이 지속적으로 오르는 현상.

meanings.de: Inflation; anhaltender Anstieg des allgemeinen Preisniveaus.
meanings.fr: Inflation ; hausse durable du niveau général des prix.
meanings.ja: インフレ。全般的な物価水準が持続して上昇すること。
meanings.zh: 通货膨胀；总体价格水平持续上升。

reason: The inherited definition presented money growth as the only cause and falling real income as inevitable; use the general price-level definition.

meaningEn: Branch or twig; a stem growing from the trunk or a larger branch of a plant.
meaningKo: 가지. 식물의 큰 줄기나 굵은 가지에서 뻗어 나온 줄기.

meanings.de: Ast oder Zweig; vom Stamm oder einem größeren Ast abgehender Pflanzenteil.
meanings.fr: Branche ou rameau ; tige issue du tronc ou d’une branche plus grande.
meanings.ja: 枝。植物の幹や太い枝から伸びる茎。
meanings.zh: 枝条；从植物主干或较大枝条上长出的部分。

reason: The English inherited gloss incorrectly required the branch to have broken off.

meaningEn: To fill; to put enough into a container or space to make it full.
meaningKo: 채우다. 용기나 공간이 가득 차도록 무언가를 넣다.

meanings.de: füllen; einen Behälter oder Raum voll machen
meanings.fr: remplir ; mettre de quoi rendre plein un récipient ou un espace
meanings.ja: 満たす。容器や空間がいっぱいになるように入れる。
meanings.zh: 装满、填满；使容器或空间充满。

reason: The inherited moon-becoming-full definition did not match the ordinary transitive verb llenar.

meaningEn: Length; the distance from one end of something to the other.
meaningKo: 길이. 한쪽 끝에서 다른 쪽 끝까지의 거리.

meanings.de: Länge; Abstand von einem Ende zum anderen.
meanings.fr: Longueur ; distance entre les deux extrémités de quelque chose.
meanings.ja: 長さ。物の一方の端から他方の端までの距離。
meanings.zh: 长度；从一端到另一端的距离。

reason: The inherited wording described being long or short rather than the measured dimension.

meaningEn: Flat or apartment; a separate dwelling within a building.
meaningKo: 아파트 한 채. 건물 안에서 독립된 주거 공간을 이루는 집.

meanings.de: Wohnung; separate Wohneinheit in einem Gebäude.
meanings.fr: Appartement ; logement indépendant à l’intérieur d’un bâtiment.
meanings.ja: アパートの一住戸。建物内の独立した住居。
meanings.zh: 公寓；建筑内的一套独立住房。

reason: The inherited definition confused an apartment with an entire residential building.

meaningEn: River basin or catchment; the area drained by a river and its tributaries.
meaningKo: 유역. 한 강과 그 지류로 물이 모여 흐르는 지역.

meanings.de: Einzugsgebiet eines Flusses und seiner Nebenflüsse.
meanings.fr: Bassin versant ; territoire drainé par un fleuve et ses affluents.
meanings.ja: 流域。川とその支流へ水が集まる地域。
meanings.zh: 流域；水流汇入一条河及其支流的区域。

reason: The inherited valley-with-a-stream definition did not match cuenca as a river basin.

meaningEn: Outstanding or distinguished; notably important or accomplished.
meaningKo: 뛰어난, 두드러진. 중요성이나 성과가 눈에 띄는.

meanings.de: herausragend oder bedeutend; durch Leistungen auffallend
meanings.fr: remarquable ou éminent ; qui se distingue par son importance ou ses réalisations
meanings.ja: 優れた、著名な。重要性や業績が際立つ。
meanings.zh: 杰出的；因重要性或成就而突出。

reason: The inherited definition required extensive career experience, which is not necessary for destacado.

meaningEn: To occupy or take up a place or space.
meaningKo: 차지하다. 장소나 공간을 사용하며 채우다.

meanings.de: einnehmen; einen Platz oder Raum beanspruchen
meanings.fr: occuper ; prendre de la place dans un lieu ou un espace
meanings.ja: 占める。場所や空間を使う。
